exports.name: getDataAttributes
exports.summary: The data attributes a part renders: `data-<part>` (or `data-<component>`), `data-orientation`, `data-disabled`, and `data-<key>` for every other option given, its value as text.

exports.name: createFrameTask
exports.summary: Runs `step` on animation frames for as long as it returns true, and sleeps otherwise: a painter with nothing left to animate costs no frames until it is woken.

exports.name: FrameTask
exports.summary: What `createFrameTask` returns: wake it when something moves, flush it to step at once, stop it for good.

exports.name: isReleased
exports.summary: A mouse or pen move with no button down: the press was released where this page could not see it, outside the window or over a menu, so the drag it belongs to is over.

exports.name: observeVisibility
exports.summary: Calls `onChange` when `element` enters or leaves the viewport, so a painter can skip frames nobody sees.

exports.name: Point
exports.summary: A point on two axes.

exports.name: clamp
exports.summary: `value` kept within `min` and `max`.

exports.name: clampFinite
exports.summary: Clamp into `min…max`; a non-finite value (NaN from a 0/0, ±Infinity) falls back to `min`.

exports.name: clampUnit
exports.summary: `value` kept within 0 and 1.

exports.name: degToRad
exports.summary: An angle in degrees, in radians.

exports.name: PI_HALF
exports.summary: A quarter turn in radians: π/2.

exports.name: quantizeRound
exports.summary: `value` rounded to the nearest multiple of `interval`.

exports.name: radToDeg
exports.summary: An angle in radians, in degrees.

exports.name: roundToStep
exports.summary: Snap to `step` with `min` as the origin, without float noise (0.1 + 0.2).

exports.name: TAU
exports.summary: A full turn in radians: 2π.

exports.name: isBlackKey
exports.summary: Whether `pitch` falls on a black key of a piano.

exports.name: pitchName
exports.summary: "C4" for middle C (MIDI 60), the naming tuners and score editors agree on.

exports.name: ChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What a change reports: why it happened (`reason`), the event behind it, the element that triggered it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: CommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What a commit reports once a gesture ends: why it happened (`reason`) and the event behind it.

exports.name: createChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: The details of a change for `reason` and `event`, with `cancel()` to refuse it and `allowPropagation()` to let the event go on.

exports.name: createPairFormatter
exports.summary: Formats two numbers as one string ("0.3, 0.4").

exports.name: moveRange
exports.summary: Moves one edge of `origin` by `delta`, or the whole range, without leaving the timeline.

exports.name: normalizeRange
exports.summary: Orders a range's edges and keeps them on the timeline.

exports.name: RangeEdge
exports.summary: What a change moves: one edge, or the whole range with `both`.

exports.name: RangeLimits
exports.summary: What a range is kept within: the timeline's length and the shortest it may be.

exports.name: RangeValue
exports.summary: A stretch of a timeline, `[start, end]` in its units.

exports.name: LINEAR_SCALE
exports.summary: Even steps: the right feel for levels, times and anything heard in differences.

exports.name: LOGARITHMIC_SCALE
exports.summary: Even ratios: the right feel for frequency, Q, ratios and times heard in proportions, where a linear sweep hides the useful range in its first few degrees.

exports.name: ParameterScale
exports.summary: How a value maps onto a control's travel, and back.

exports.name: ParameterScaleProp
exports.summary: A scale as an option takes it: `"linear"`, `"log"`, or a scale of your own.

exports.name: resolveScale
exports.summary: The scale an option names: `"linear"` and `"log"` as `LINEAR_SCALE` and `LOGARITHMIC_SCALE`, a scale of your own as it is.

exports.name: createSource
exports.summary: Creates a source you push to yourself, from an audio callback, a WebSocket, a worker or a test: call `set` with each new reading, and whatever reads the source follows.

exports.name: Source
exports.summary: A value that changes outside React, in the shape `useSyncExternalStore` expects: `subscribe` registers a listener called on each change, and `getSnapshot` returns the current value.

exports.name: WritableSource
exports.summary: A source that also takes values: what `createSource` returns.

exports.name: createStore
exports.summary: A store holding `initial`: `set` tells every listener, unless the value is the same one.

exports.name: Store
exports.summary: A value that can be read and observed outside React, in the shape `useSyncExternalStore` expects.

exports.name: createEnvelopeController
exports.summary: An envelope's behavior with no view attached: its points, held or controlled, every way of moving, adding, removing and bending them, and what it looks like as a snapshot.

exports.name: EnvelopeChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change: the `index` of the point or segment, the reason, the event behind it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: EnvelopeChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the points changed: `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"add"`, `"remove"` or `"curve"` (a bend).

exports.name: EnvelopeCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the `index` of the point or segment, the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: EnvelopeCommitEventReason
exports.summary: Why the points were committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: EnvelopeController
exports.summary: What `createEnvelopeController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and a call for each gesture and key that moves, adds, removes, bends or straightens.

exports.name: EnvelopeOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createEnvelopeController`: the points, held or controlled, how few and how many there may be, the grid they snap to, the keyboard step, the formatting and the callbacks.

exports.name: EnvelopeSnap
exports.summary: A grid step in normalized units: one for both axes, or one for each (0 leaves that axis free).

exports.name: EnvelopeSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws an envelope from.

exports.name: Breakpoint
exports.summary: A point of the ramp, and how the segment leaving it bends: `curve` from -1 to 1, 0 or unset for a straight line.

exports.name: CURVE_EPSILON
exports.summary: A curve this close to flat is taken as straight, and dropped.

exports.name: CURVE_HIT_TOLERANCE
exports.summary: How far from a curve, as a share of the graph's height, a press still counts as on it.

exports.name: CURVE_RATE
exports.summary: How far a segment can bend: the rate of its exponential at the ends of -1…1, which puts the middle of the segment at 0.4% of its rise (or 99.6%).

exports.name: CURVE_SAMPLES
exports.summary: Straight lines between samples of a bent segment: where its drawing starts, before it adds vertices where the bend is tight.

exports.name: CURVE_STEP_MULTIPLIER
exports.summary: Keyboard step for a segment's curve, as a multiple of `step`.

exports.name: clampToNeighbors
exports.summary: Clamp a candidate point's x between its neighbors in `base` (so points can never cross or reorder) and y to [0,1].

exports.name: curveForMidpoint
exports.summary: The curve that puts a segment's midpoint at height `y`, or null when the segment is flat and has nothing to bend.

exports.name: curveKeyDelta
exports.summary: How far a key bends a segment, or null for a key that does not: up lifts the handle, so a rising segment bends one way and a falling one the other.

exports.name: curveSamples
exports.summary: Where along a bent segment to put the vertices of its drawing: evenly in length, and evenly in height, so a steep stretch is sampled as finely as a flat one and does not turn into a corner.

exports.name: insertPoint
exports.summary: `point` added to `base`.

exports.name: LARGE_STEP_MULTIPLIER
exports.summary: Shift + arrows move this many steps at once.

exports.name: levelAt
exports.summary: Where a bent segment is at a share `t` of its length, as a level.

exports.name: polylinePoints
exports.summary: Polyline coordinates: flat lead-in from x=0 to the first point, the points themselves with each bent segment sampled between them, flat lead-out from the last point to x=1.

exports.name: roundCoord
exports.summary: One decimal place is plenty of precision for a 0-100 SVG coordinate, and keeps the `points` string short during drag.

exports.name: samePoints
exports.summary: Whether two lists hold the same points, curves included, in the same order.

exports.name: sanitizePoints
exports.summary: The points kept on the graph: each within 0 and 1, a curve within -1 and 1 (dropped when it is flat), in order along x.

exports.name: segmentNear
exports.summary: The segment that has the point (x, y) on it or close to it, or null: one that is not flat, since a flat segment has nothing to bend.

exports.name: segmentShape
exports.summary: Where along a bent segment a share `t` of its length lands, as a share of its rise: the exponential of an analog envelope stage, `(e^(k·t) - 1) / (e^k - 1)` with `k` the curve times `CURVE_RATE`.

exports.name: snapTo
exports.summary: Rounds a normalized coordinate to the nearest multiple of `step`; a step of 0 leaves it.

exports.name: sortPoints
exports.summary: The points in order along x.

exports.name: createFaderController
exports.summary: A fader's behavior with no view attached: its value, held or controlled, every way of changing it, and what it looks like as a snapshot.

exports.name: FaderChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change: the reason, the event behind it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: FaderChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value changed: `"drag"`, `"track-press"`, `"keyboard"`, `"wheel"`, `"input-change"` (a typed value) or `"reset"`.

exports.name: FaderCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: FaderCommitEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value was committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: FaderController
exports.summary: What `createFaderController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the press, keys, wheel, typed value and reset that change it.

exports.name: FaderOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createFaderController`: the value, held or controlled, its range, steps, anchor and orientation, its formatting and the callbacks.

exports.name: FaderOrientation
exports.summary: Which way a fader's travel runs.

exports.name: FaderSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a fader from.

exports.name: faderShare
exports.summary: The share of the travel `value` sits at, 0…100.

exports.name: DEFAULT_MAX
exports.summary: The top of a fader's range unless given: 6.

exports.name: DEFAULT_MIN
exports.summary: The bottom of a fader's range unless given: -60, as for a level in dB.

exports.name: WHEEL_DELTA_EPSILON
exports.summary: A wheel movement smaller than this is ignored.

exports.name: createKnobController
exports.summary: A knob's behavior with no view attached: its value, held or controlled, every way of turning it, and what it looks like as a snapshot.

exports.name: KnobChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change: the reason, the event behind it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: KnobChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value changed: `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"wheel"`, `"input-change"` (a typed value) or `"reset"`.

exports.name: KnobCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: KnobCommitEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value was committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: KnobController
exports.summary: What `createKnobController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the press, keys, wheel, typed value and reset that turn it.

exports.name: KnobDragMode
exports.summary: How a drag turns a knob: up and down, around its centre, or by the turns of the pointer.

exports.name: KnobOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createKnobController`: the value, held or controlled, its range, scale, steps and anchor, the drag mode, the formatting and the callbacks.

exports.name: KnobSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a knob from.

exports.name: ANGLE_GAP_RAD
exports.summary: Gap at the bottom of the dial: the sweep runs clockwise from bottom-left to bottom-right.

exports.name: ARC_OUTER_RADIUS
exports.summary: Outer edge of the arcs in the viewBox; each stroke is centered inside it.

exports.name: arcPath
exports.summary: SVG arc along the dial between two normalized positions (0…1).

exports.name: CENTER_DEAD_ZONE_MIN_PX
exports.summary: The smallest the hub's dead zone may be, in px, however small the knob.

exports.name: CENTER_DEAD_ZONE_REL
exports.summary: Circular drag: inside this fraction of the diameter the angle is synced but not accumulated, so crossing the hub doesn't jump.

exports.name: DEFAULT_ARC_STROKE_WIDTH
exports.summary: The width of the track and indicator arcs in the 48 by 48 view box, unless given.

exports.name: DOUBLE_TAP_MAX_MS
exports.summary: The longest two taps may be apart, in ms, to count as a double tap and reset the value.

exports.name: FINE_DRAG
exports.summary: Holding Shift turns the knob this much slower than the pointer moves.

exports.name: LARGE_POSITION_STEP
exports.summary: With a scale that is not linear, a large step (Shift or Page Up and Down) moves this share of the travel.

exports.name: LINEAR
exports.summary: The linear scale, resolved once.

exports.name: POSITION_STEP
exports.summary: With a scale that isn't linear, a key or wheel notch moves this share of the travel.

exports.name: pointerAngle
exports.summary: The angle of a pointer around the centre of `rect`, in radians, 0 pointing right.

exports.name: START_ANGLE
exports.summary: Rotation at `min`, in degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock.

exports.name: STATE_ATTRIBUTES_MAPPING
exports.summary: `disabled`, `dragging` and the drag mode become data attributes; the numbers stay in `state`.

exports.name: SWEEP_ANGLE
exports.summary: Rotation travelled from `min` to `max`, in degrees.

exports.name: steppedValue
exports.summary: The value `direction` steps away from `current`: by `step` (or `largeStep`) on a linear scale, by a share of the travel on any other, and always by at least one `step`.

exports.name: TAP_MAX_MOVE_PX
exports.summary: A press that moves less than this is a tap; two quick taps reset the value.

exports.name: VERTICAL_DRAG_RANGE_PX
exports.summary: Vertical drag: pointer travel, in px, for the whole `min…max` range.

exports.name: VIEWBOX_CENTER
exports.summary: Center of the 48×48 viewBox the arcs are drawn in.

exports.name: WHEEL_DELTA_EPSILON
exports.summary: A wheel movement smaller than this is ignored.

exports.name: createPpmBallistics
exports.summary: A PPM meter: it rises in `attackSeconds`, a time constant, and falls at a steady `releaseDbPerSecond`, so a peak reads long enough to be seen.

exports.name: createVuBallistics
exports.summary: A VU meter: its pointer follows the voltage of the level as a mass on a spring does, symmetrically, taking `riseSeconds` to first reach 99% of a step and overshooting it by 1.3%, as the standard says.

exports.name: FLOOR_DB
exports.summary: The lowest reading a meter shows, in dB: below it the level is silence.

exports.name: MeterBallistics
exports.summary: How a meter's reading follows the level it measures, over time.

exports.name: iecDeflection
exports.summary: The deflection of an IEC 60268-18 style digital peak meter, from 0 at -70 dB to 100 at 0 dB: each stretch of the scale gets more room than the one below, so the top 20 dB take half the length.

exports.name: LevelScale
exports.summary: How a level in dB is spread along the meter's length: evenly, or the way digital peak meters spread it, with room at the top where it matters.

exports.name: LevelScaleFunction
exports.summary: A custom curve: any increasing function of the level, rescaled to the meter's range.

exports.name: levelPosition
exports.summary: A function from a level to its position along the length, 0 at `min` and 1 at `max`.

exports.name: vuDeflection
exports.summary: The deflection of a VU meter's pointer.

exports.name: channelView
exports.summary: What a channel shows for its reading in `frame`: the length of its bar, its peak mark, whether it warns or clips, and its text.

exports.name: createMeterConfig
exports.summary: Builds the config a meter reads its levels with: the position along its length, and how levels are written.

exports.name: DEFAULT_METER_FORMAT
exports.summary: Levels read to one decimal: finer than a meter can be read, and a plain number rather than a share of the range.

exports.name: MeterChannelNodes
exports.summary: The DOM nodes of one channel that a live source writes to.

exports.name: MeterChannelPart
exports.summary: A part of a channel that a live source writes to.

exports.name: MeterChannelView
exports.summary: What one channel shows for a level: everything both the React render and the per-frame DOM writes derive from.

exports.name: MeterConfig
exports.summary: What `createMeterConfig` returns: the range, the warning and clipping levels, the position of a level along the meter, and how a level is written.

exports.name: MeterFrame
exports.summary: One reading of the meter: a level per channel, and optionally a peak-hold level per channel.

exports.name: MeterOrientation
exports.summary: Which way a meter's bars run.

exports.name: paintChannel
exports.summary: Write one channel's view straight to its nodes, touching only what changed.

exports.name: setPresence
exports.summary: Sets `attribute` on `node` as an empty attribute, or removes it.

exports.name: createPadController
exports.summary: A grid of pads with no view attached: which pads sound, struck by pointer or keyboard, how hard, which ones choke each other, and where the grid's one tab stop is.

exports.name: KEYBOARD_VELOCITY
exports.summary: What a pad struck from the keyboard sounds at.

exports.name: MIN_VELOCITY
exports.summary: The softest a pointer strike plays: the very bottom of a pad, not silence.

exports.name: PadController
exports.summary: What `createPadController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the strikes, keys and focus moves of the grid.

exports.name: PadOffEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onPadOff` receives when a pad stops: the reason (`"press"`, `"keyboard"`, or `"choke"` when another pad of its choke group cut it) and the event.

exports.name: PadOnEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onPadOn` receives with a strike: its `velocity`, from 0 to 1, the reason (`"press"` or `"keyboard"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: PadOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createPadController`: the pads in reading order, the columns of the grid, the pads lit or disabled from elsewhere, and the callbacks.

exports.name: PadSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws the pads from: the ones sounding and how hard, the tab stop, and whether the grid is disabled.

exports.name: PadTarget
exports.summary: A pad as a strike sees it.

exports.name: padTarget
exports.summary: The index the arrow and Home/End keys move to from `index` in a grid of `count` pads, `columns` to a row: left and right step through the reading order, up and down by a row.

exports.name: strikeVelocity
exports.summary: How hard a pointer strikes: the force it reports when it can measure one, such as a pen or a pressure-sensitive screen, else where it lands, harder toward the top of the pad.

exports.name: createPianoController
exports.summary: A keyboard's behavior with no view attached: which keys sound, by pointer, glide or keyboard, how hard, and where the keyboard's one tab stop is.

exports.name: KEYBOARD_VELOCITY
exports.summary: What a key played from the keyboard sounds at.

exports.name: MIN_VELOCITY
exports.summary: The softest a pointer press plays: the very top of a key, not silence.

exports.name: PianoController
exports.summary: What `createPianoController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, keys and focus moves of the keyboard.

exports.name: PianoNoteOffEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onNoteOff` receives when a key stops: the reason (`"press"`, `"glide"` or `"keyboard"`) and the event.

exports.name: PianoNoteOnEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onNoteOn` receives when a key sounds: its `velocity`, from 0 to 1, the reason (`"press"`, `"glide"` or `"keyboard"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: PianoOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createPianoController`: the pitches, their layout and orientation, the notes lit from elsewhere, and the callbacks.

exports.name: PianoSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws the keyboard from: the pitches and where each key sits, the ones sounding, and the tab stop.

exports.name: BLACK_KEY_DEPTH
exports.summary: How far across the keyboard a black key reaches; past it, a press lands on a white key.

exports.name: KeyLayout
exports.summary: How the keys share the keyboard's length: `"keyboard"` like a piano, white keys side by side with the black ones between them, or `"even"`, one equal share each, the way a piano roll's rows are.

exports.name: KeyPlacement
exports.summary: Where a key sits along the keyboard, how much of it it takes, and whether it is black.

exports.name: keyAt
exports.summary: The key under a point, given as shares of the keyboard: `along` its length from the low end, `across` its depth from the back, where black keys are.

exports.name: placeKeys
exports.summary: Where each of `pitches` (lowest first) sits along the keyboard.

exports.name: createPianoRollController
exports.summary: A piano roll's behavior with no view attached: its notes, held or controlled, its selection and the pitches sounding, and every gesture and key that edits them.

exports.name: DRAG_THRESHOLD
exports.summary: How far a pointer moves before a press on the grid or a note becomes a drag.

exports.name: PianoRollBand
exports.summary: A selection rectangle, in px from the grid's top left corner.

exports.name: PianoRollChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change: the `edit` it made (one for every change of a gesture), the reason, the event behind it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: PianoRollChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the notes changed: `"draw"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"double-click"` or `"input-change"`.

exports.name: PianoRollCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the `edit` it made (one for every change of a gesture), the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: PianoRollCommitEventReason
exports.summary: Why the notes were committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: PianoRollController
exports.summary: What `createPianoRollController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and a call for each gesture, key and command that edits the notes or the selection.

exports.name: PianoRollEdit
exports.summary: What a change did to the notes.

exports.name: PianoRollKeyDetails
exports.summary: A key pressed on the keyboard beside the roll, before it sounds.

exports.name: PianoRollNoteHandle
exports.summary: Which pointer handle a note gesture takes: its body, or one of its edges.

exports.name: PianoRollNoteOffEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onNoteOff` receives when a pitch stops: the reason and the event.

exports.name: PianoRollNoteOnEventDetails
exports.summary: Why a pitch sounds: a key pressed, glided onto or played from the keyboard, or a note drawn, picked up or moved.

exports.name: PianoRollOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createPianoRollController`: the notes and the selection, each held or controlled, the timeline, the pitch range and shortest note, the mode, the draw style, the scale and folding, and the callbacks.

exports.name: PianoRollSelectionEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onSelectionChange` receives: the reason (`"press"`, `"marquee"`, `"draw"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"` or `"double-click"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: PianoRollSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws the roll from.

exports.name: PianoRollTimeline
exports.summary: The timeline the roll sits in: its length, grid, zoom and playback position.

exports.name: cellStart
exports.summary: The start of the grid cell `value` falls in: where a note drawn there begins.

exports.name: changeLevel
exports.summary: Changes `level` of every note in `ids` by `delta`, each kept within 0…1, so the notes keep their differences: the velocity, or the chance to play.

exports.name: changeVelocity
exports.summary: Changes the velocity of every note in `ids` by `delta`, each kept within 0…1: a phrase keeps its dynamics, where setting them all to one value would flatten it.

exports.name: chopNotes
exports.summary: Chops each note in `ids` into `parts` notes of the same length, as many as fit at `minLength` or longer: a held note becomes a repeated one.

exports.name: deleteTime
exports.summary: Takes the time from `start` to `end` out of the clip: the notes inside it go, those after it move back by its length, and one crossing it loses the part inside.

exports.name: duplicateAfter
exports.summary: Copies of the notes in `ids` placed right after them, one selection's length on, so a phrase repeats itself the way it is played.

exports.name: duplicateNotes
exports.summary: Copies of the notes in `ids`, under new ids from `nextId`, left where the originals are.

exports.name: duplicateTime
exports.summary: Repeats the time from `start` to `end` right after itself: silence opens at `end` and the notes in the range, cut to it, are copied into it under new ids.

exports.name: findNotes
exports.summary: The ids of the notes that match `query`, in the order they play: to select every note of a pitch, a range of velocities or lengths, out of a scale, or every other one.

exports.name: fitNotesToScale
exports.summary: Moves each note in `ids` that is out of `scale` to the nearest pitch in it, the lower of two as near.

exports.name: humanizeNotes
exports.summary: Loosens the notes in `ids` the way a player would: each start moves by up to `timing` either way and each velocity by up to `velocity`, from `random` (0…1, `Math.random` by default).

exports.name: insertTime
exports.summary: Opens `length` of silence at `at`: the notes from there on move later by it, one crossing `at` is split there with its second part moved along, and what then runs past the clip's `duration` is cut off.

exports.name: invertNotes
exports.summary: Turns the notes in `ids` upside down: the highest becomes the lowest, around the middle of their range.

exports.name: joinNotes
exports.summary: Joins the notes in `ids` that share a pitch into one, from the earliest start to the latest end: the earliest keeps its id and velocity.

exports.name: keyboardEdit
exports.summary: What an arrow key does to the notes in `ids`: Left and Right move them by `step`, or with Shift change their length; Up and Down move them by a semitone, or with Shift an octave.

exports.name: legatoNotes
exports.summary: Lengthens or shortens each note in `ids` to end where the next of them starts, so a phrase plays without gaps.

exports.name: moveNotes
exports.summary: Moves the notes in `ids` by the same amount, in time and in pitch, so a chord keeps its spacing.

exports.name: Note
exports.summary: A note on the roll: its pitch, start and length, how hard and how likely it plays, how far its velocity may stray, and whether it is deactivated.

exports.name: NoteId
exports.summary: A note's id: unique within its clip.

exports.name: NoteLevel
exports.summary: A note's value a lane draws as a bar, 0…1: how hard it plays, or how likely it is to.

exports.name: NoteQuery
exports.summary: What `findNotes` looks for; every condition given must hold.

exports.name: notesWithin
exports.summary: The ids of the notes overlapping a stretch of time and a band of rows.

exports.name: pasteNotes
exports.summary: Copies of `clipboard` under new ids, the earliest starting at `at`: a phrase keeps its spacing wherever it lands, and stops where the roll ends.

exports.name: quantizeNotes
exports.summary: The notes in `ids` with their start on the nearest grid line: their length, and the rest, stay.

exports.name: RollBounds
exports.summary: What every edit keeps a note within: the timeline's length, the pitch range and the shortest length.

exports.name: rampVelocity
exports.summary: Sets the velocity of the notes in `ids` along a line, from `from` on the earliest to `to` on the latest: a crescendo, or a fade.

exports.name: resizeNotes
exports.summary: Moves one edge of every note in `ids` by `delta`: the end makes them longer or shorter, the start trims them from the front while their end stays put.

exports.name: reverseNotes
exports.summary: Plays the notes in `ids` backwards: each lands where it would end, mirrored across their span.

exports.name: sameNotes
exports.summary: Whether two lists hold the same notes, in the same order.

exports.name: sanitizeNote
exports.summary: Keeps a note on the roll: inside the timeline, in the pitch range, at least `minLength` long.

exports.name: selectionSpan
exports.summary: The time the notes in `ids` cover, from the earliest start to the latest end, or null with none.

exports.name: setChance
exports.summary: Sets how likely the notes in `ids` are to play each time round, 0…1: 1 always, 0.5 every other time on average.

exports.name: setDeviation
exports.summary: Sets how far the velocity of the notes in `ids` may stray each time they play, kept within -1…1.

exports.name: snapEdgeDelta
exports.summary: How far the edge of `note` moves when dragged by `delta`, on the grid unless `grid.step` is 0.

exports.name: spatialOrder
exports.summary: Notes in the order the eye reads them: left to right, then top to bottom.

exports.name: splitNotes
exports.summary: Splits the notes in `ids` at `at`, or at each time in it, wherever a note holds that time: the first piece keeps the note's id, the others take new ones.

exports.name: stretchNotes
exports.summary: Makes the notes in `ids` `factor` times as long, around `anchor` (where the earliest starts, by default): 2 plays them at half the speed, 0.5 at twice.

exports.name: toggleMuted
exports.summary: Deactivates the notes in `ids`, or activates them again when every one of them already is: a deactivated note stays on the roll and does not play.

exports.name: RollScale
exports.summary: A scale as a piano roll reads it: the pitch classes it keeps and the one it starts on, each from 0 (C) to 11 (B).

exports.name: Rows
exports.summary: The rows a piano roll draws, highest pitch first, and the conversions between a pitch and its row.

exports.name: rollRows
exports.summary: The rows for pitches `min` to `max`: every one, or folded to just those the notes use, and with `"scale"` those in `scale` as well.

exports.name: PlotAxis
exports.summary: One of the plot's two axes: its range and how values spread along it.

exports.name: positionOn
exports.summary: Where `value` sits along `axis`, 0 at its `min` to 1 at its `max`.

exports.name: valueOn
exports.summary: The value at `position` (0…1) along `axis`.

exports.name: createPlotHandleController
exports.summary: A handle's behavior with no view attached: its value, held or controlled, every way of moving it, and what it looks like as a snapshot.

exports.name: PlotHandleAxis
exports.summary: The axes a handle moves along; the other keeps its value.

exports.name: PlotHandleChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change: the reason, the event behind it, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: PlotHandleChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value changed: `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"input-change"` (a typed value) or `"reset"`.

exports.name: PlotHandleCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: PlotHandleCommitEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value was committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: PlotHandleController
exports.summary: What `createPlotHandleController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the press, keys, typed values and reset that move the handle.

exports.name: PlotHandleOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createPlotHandleController`: the value, held or controlled, the axes it moves along, how to measure the plot, and the callbacks.

exports.name: PlotHandleSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a handle from.

exports.name: PlotPoint
exports.summary: A point on the plot, in the axes' units.

exports.name: curvePath
exports.summary: An SVG path drawing `y = fn(x)` across the whole x axis, in a 1 × 1 box with y going up.

exports.name: tracePath
exports.summary: An SVG path through `values` spread evenly across the whole x axis, in the same 1 × 1 box with y going up: a spectrum, a level history, anything that arrives as a list.

exports.name: axisTicks
exports.summary: Round, evenly-spread tick values for `axis`: by power of ten when it is logarithmic.

exports.name: DEFAULT_TICK_COUNT
exports.summary: How many ticks an axis gets unless asked for another number.

exports.name: formatTick
exports.summary: A tick as short text: 1000 as "1k", 0.5 as "0.5", -12 as "-12".

exports.name: createSequencerController
exports.summary: A sequencer's behavior with no view attached: its pattern and velocities, held or controlled, its tab stop, and every way of painting them.

exports.name: SequencerCellNodes
exports.summary: Which element a pointer gesture reads its cells from: a map of the cell elements by key.

exports.name: SequencerController
exports.summary: What `createSequencerController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, paint strokes, keys and focus moves that edit the grid.

exports.name: SequencerOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createSequencerController`: the pattern and the velocities, each held or controlled, and the callbacks.

exports.name: SequencerSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws the sequencer from.

exports.name: SequencerValueChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change to the pattern: the reason (`"press"`, `"paint"` or `"keyboard"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: SequencerValueCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture on the pattern ends: the reason and the event.

exports.name: SequencerVelocityChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onVelocityChange` receives with each change to the velocities: the reason (`"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"input-change"` or `"reset"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: SequencerVelocityCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onVelocityCommitted` receives once a gesture on the velocities ends: the reason and the event.

exports.name: CellAddress
exports.summary: A cell of the grid: its row and its step.

exports.name: cellAtPoint
exports.summary: The cell whose box holds the point, from the boxes of every cell.

exports.name: cellKey
exports.summary: A cell's address as a string key, `"row:step"`.

exports.name: DEFAULT_VELOCITY
exports.summary: What a step plays at until it is set.

exports.name: isOn
exports.summary: Whether `pattern` has the cell on.

exports.name: moveFocus
exports.summary: Where an arrow, Home or End key takes the focus from `from`, kept inside the grid.

exports.name: Pattern
exports.summary: Which steps are on: a row per sound, a cell per step.

exports.name: setCell
exports.summary: `pattern` with one cell set; the same pattern when it already is.

exports.name: setVelocity
exports.summary: `velocities` with one step set, grown to `rows` × `steps`; the same values when it already is.

exports.name: Velocities
exports.summary: Loudness per step, 0…1: a row per sound, like the pattern.

exports.name: velocityAt
exports.summary: The velocity of one step.

exports.name: velocityAtY
exports.summary: The velocity a press at `clientY` sets on a bar: its bottom is silent, its top full.

exports.name: ClipLimits
exports.summary: What a clip edit keeps a clip within: the timeline's length, the shortest it may be, and its source's length.

exports.name: ClipValue
exports.summary: A clip: a stretch of a source (a recording, a pattern) placed on the timeline.

exports.name: clipEnd
exports.summary: Where the clip ends on the timeline.

exports.name: copyRange
exports.summary: What the stretch from `from` to `to` holds of `items`: the part of each clip inside it, moved so the stretch starts at 0.

exports.name: coverClips
exports.summary: What a clip laid on a lane leaves of the clips already there: they are covered, not stacked.

exports.name: duplicateClip
exports.summary: A copy of the clip placed right after it, or as late as the timeline allows when there is not room for it.

exports.name: FADE_SHAPES
exports.summary: The fade shapes in the order a control steps through them.

exports.name: FadeShape
exports.summary: How a fade rises or falls: evenly, quick then slow, slow then quick, or eased at both ends.

exports.name: fadeGain
exports.summary: The gain a fade of `shape` has `progress` of the way through it, from 0 (silent) to 1 (full): the curve of a fade-in; a fade-out plays it backwards.

exports.name: insertTime
exports.summary: Opens a stretch `length` long at `at`: everything from there moves later, and a clip across `at` is cut in two around the gap.

exports.name: moveClip
exports.summary: Moves the clip to begin at `start`, keeping its length and its place in the source.

exports.name: nextFadeShape
exports.summary: The shape after `shape`, going round, for a control that steps through them.

exports.name: removeTime
exports.summary: Takes the stretch from `from` to `to` out of the timeline: what is in it goes, and everything after it moves back to close the gap.

exports.name: setClipFadeIn
exports.summary: Sets the fade-in's length, which cannot run into the fade-out.

exports.name: setClipFadeOut
exports.summary: Sets the fade-out's length, which cannot run into the fade-in.

exports.name: setClipFadeShape
exports.summary: Gives the fade at `edge` the shape `shape`.

exports.name: splitClip
exports.summary: Cuts the clip in two at `at`, a position on the timeline.

exports.name: trimClipEnd
exports.summary: Trims the clip's end to `end`, as far as the timeline and the source allow.

exports.name: trimClipStart
exports.summary: Trims the clip's start to `start`: what is cut off stays in the source, so the clip's content does not move on the timeline.

exports.name: ClipChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change to a clip: what moved (`target`), for a move how far and over which lane, whether Alt asks for a copy, the reason (`"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"input-change"` or `"double-click"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: ClipCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture on a clip ends: what moved, the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: ClipController
exports.summary: What `createClipController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, keys, typed values and fade shapes that move, trim and fade the clip, and select it.

exports.name: ClipOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createClipController`: the clip and its selection, each held or controlled, the timeline's length, grid, steps and zoom, the shortest length, the source's length, and the callbacks.

exports.name: ClipSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a clip from: its value, whether it is selected, and what a drag is moving and by how much.

exports.name: ClipTarget
exports.summary: What a change to the clip moves.

exports.name: createClipController
exports.summary: A clip's behavior with no view attached: its span, held or controlled, moved, trimmed or faded by the pointer or the keys, and selected.

exports.name: keyTargets
exports.summary: The keys' targets for an edge or a clip, moved by the keyboard.

exports.name: laneUnder
exports.summary: The lane the pointer is over, if any: the element that marks itself as one.

exports.name: normalizeClip
exports.summary: The clip as the timeline holds it: finite, on the timeline, fades within its length.

exports.name: sameClip
exports.summary: Whether two clips hold the same values.

exports.name: wholeClip
exports.summary: The clip a timeline without one starts with: the whole of it, from the source's start.

exports.name: adjacentPoint
exports.summary: The nearest of `points` strictly after `from` (`direction` 1) or strictly before it (`direction` -1), or null when there is none that way: what jumping to the next or the previous locator, or cue, needs.

exports.name: createNavigatorController
exports.summary: The navigator's behavior: a bar with the stretch the viewport shows inside it, which a drag or a key moves.

exports.name: movedRange
exports.summary: Where `part` lands when moved by `delta` units from `from`, within the timeline.

exports.name: NavigatorController
exports.summary: What `createNavigatorController` returns: the stretch the window shows, and the presses, keys, typed values and double click that move it.

exports.name: NavigatorMetrics
exports.summary: How the viewport is scrolled and zoomed, as last laid out.

exports.name: NavigatorOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createNavigatorController`: the timeline's length, how the viewport is laid out, the functions that scroll and zoom it, and the narrowest the window may be.

exports.name: NavigatorPart
exports.summary: The part of the navigator a gesture moves: one of its edges, or the window between them.

exports.name: rangeOfThumb
exports.summary: The stretch a window drawn from `thumb[0]` to `thumb[1]` px shows: `thumbOf` read back.

exports.name: thumbOf
exports.summary: The window as it is drawn on a bar `bar` px wide, its two edges in px, for the stretch `range`: never narrower than `least`, and inside the bar, at the end of the timeline too.

exports.name: visibleRange
exports.summary: The stretch of the timeline the viewport shows, in units.

exports.name: createTimelineController
exports.summary: The timeline's playback position and zoom, with no view attached: held, controlled or live, moved by a press, a drag, a key or an input, and zoomed.

exports.name: TimelineController
exports.summary: What `createTimelineController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, keys, typed values and zooms that move the playhead or the view.

exports.name: TimelineOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createTimelineController`: the position and the zoom, each held, controlled or (the position) live, the timeline's length, grid and steps, the zoom's bounds, and the callbacks.

exports.name: TimelinePositionChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onPositionChange` receives with each move of the playhead: the reason (`"press"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"` or `"input-change"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse the move.

exports.name: TimelinePositionCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onPositionCommitted` receives once a move of the playhead ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: TimelineSelectionHandlers
exports.summary: Listens to the stretch a Shift + drag on the ruler selects: set by the ruler.

exports.name: TimelineSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws the timeline from.

exports.name: TimelineZoomChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onZoomChange` receives with each zoom: the reason (`"wheel"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"input-change"` or `"double-click"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: valueAtLane
exports.summary: The timeline's units under a point of `lane`, clamped to the timeline.

exports.name: createRangeController
exports.summary: A range's behavior with no view attached: its span on the timeline, held or controlled, moved or resized by its body or its edges, drawn across empty lane, and moved by the keys and inputs.

exports.name: drawnRangeWidth
exports.summary: How wide a range `width` px long is drawn, so that it keeps `least` px of room for its handles: from `2 * least` px up, as long as it is, and under that it still grows with its length, at half the rate.

exports.name: RangeChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each change to a range: which `edge` moved, or `"both"`, the reason (`"drag"`, `"draw"`, `"keyboard"` or `"input-change"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse the change.

exports.name: RangeCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture on a range ends: which edge moved, the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: RangeController
exports.summary: What `createRangeController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, draws, keys and typed values that move and resize the range.

exports.name: RangeOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createRangeController`: the range, held or controlled, the timeline's length, grid, steps and zoom, the shortest length, whether it can be moved or drawn, and the callbacks.

exports.name: RangeSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a range from.

exports.name: rangeWidthOfDrawn
exports.summary: How long a range is, in px, when it is drawn `drawn` px wide.

exports.name: anchoredScroll
exports.summary: Where the viewport must scroll so `anchor.value` stays `anchor.offset` px from its start at the new zoom.

exports.name: clampZoom
exports.summary: Keeps `zoom` within its bounds; anything that is not a positive number is refused.

exports.name: valueAtOffset
exports.summary: The value under a point `offset` px from the viewport's start.

exports.name: ZoomAnchor
exports.summary: A point held still through a zoom: a value, and how far from the viewport's start it sits, in px.

exports.name: bypassesGrid
exports.summary: Whether a gesture asks to ignore the grid: Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere.

exports.name: Grid
exports.summary: Grid lines `step` apart, starting from `offset`.

exports.name: nearestSnapPoint
exports.summary: The point of `grid` nearest `value` within its radius, or null when none is that close.

exports.name: SNAP_RADIUS_PX
exports.summary: How far from a snap point, in px, a dragged thing is pulled onto it.

exports.name: snapMove
exports.summary: Where something dragged from `origin` should land, given where the pointer would put it.

exports.name: snapRangeMove
exports.summary: Where one edge of a range dragged from `origin`, or the whole range with `"both"`, should land when the pointer has moved it by `delta`: the dragged edge snaps the way anything dragged does, and the range keeps within the timeline and its minimum length.

exports.name: snapSpanMove
exports.summary: Where a span `length` long, dragged from `origin`, should start when the pointer would start it at `target`: either of its edges lands on a snap point within reach (the nearer one wins), or else its start snaps the way anything dragged does.

exports.name: snapToGrid
exports.summary: The snap point within reach of `value`, or else the grid line nearest it.

exports.name: withoutSnapPoints
exports.summary: The grid without the given points, so something dragged is not pulled onto its own edges.

exports.name: withSnapRadius
exports.summary: The grid with its points pulling from `radius` units away, so a gesture can set it from its own zoom.

exports.name: createTrackController
exports.summary: A track's height, with no view attached: what a drag, a key, an input or a double click asks of it.

exports.name: TrackController
exports.summary: What `createTrackController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the presses, keys, typed values and reset that ask for a height.

exports.name: TrackHeightChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onHeightChange` receives with each resize of a track: the reason (`"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"input-change"` or `"double-click"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: TrackHeightCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onHeightCommitted` receives once a resize ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: TrackOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createTrackController`: the height its parent holds, its bounds and steps, how to measure it, and the callbacks.

exports.name: TrackSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a track's resize handle from: whether a resize is under way.

exports.name: createWheelZoom
exports.summary: A wheel zoom around the pointer.

exports.name: WHEEL_ZOOM_SENSITIVITY
exports.summary: How far one unit of wheel delta zooms, as an exponent.

exports.name: WheelZoomController
exports.summary: What `createWheelZoom` returns: the wheel handler, `setOptions`, and `dispose`.

exports.name: WheelZoomOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createWheelZoom`: the timeline's length, the zoom as drawn, where its start sits, and the function that applies a zoom.

exports.name: BarLayout
exports.summary: Where the bars go on the canvas bitmap.

exports.name: BarLayoutOptions
exports.summary: What `barLayout` lays bars out for: the canvas's size and pixel ratio, the bars' width, gap and shortest height, and the variant.

exports.name: BarRect
exports.summary: A bar's rectangle on the bitmap, in whole device pixels.

exports.name: barCount
exports.summary: How many bars of `barWidth` separated by `barGap` fit in `width`.

exports.name: barLayout
exports.summary: Lay the bars out on the device pixel grid.

exports.name: barRect
exports.summary: Where bar `index` goes for a level of 0…1, in whole device pixels.

exports.name: barRects
exports.summary: Where each level goes, left to right.

exports.name: bitmapLength
exports.summary: How many device pixels a CSS length covers on the canvas bitmap.

exports.name: envelopeRects
exports.summary: Where each bar of an envelope goes, in whole device pixels: from its high to its low around the middle, never thinner than the shortest bar.

exports.name: mirroredScrollRects
exports.summary: Where each level of a history goes when it scrolls outwards from the middle, left to right: the newest stays in the center, growing out of the one before it, while older ones slide away on both sides.

exports.name: scrollShift
exports.summary: How far to shift a row of `count` bars so the last one sits flush with the right edge once it has fully slid in.

exports.name: WaveformVariant
exports.summary: `bars` stands the bars on the baseline, `mirror` centers them on the middle line, and `line` joins the levels into one continuous, centered shape.

exports.name: createLevelHistory
exports.summary: Records a level every `intervalMs` into a window of `size` entries that scrolls: each new entry pushes the oldest one out.

exports.name: LevelHistory
exports.summary: What `createLevelHistory` returns: feed it levels, step it every frame, and read the window it scrolls and how far the newest entry has slid in.

exports.name: isAudible
exports.summary: Whether `levels` carry a signal, rather than silence.

exports.name: loudest
exports.summary: The loudest magnitude in `levels`.

exports.name: SILENCE_THRESHOLD
exports.summary: Loudest level under which a signal counts as silence.

exports.name: createLevelsEngine
exports.summary: Turns an input of any length into the level of each of `count` bars: fitted to the bar count, rising at once and falling smoothly, optionally mirrored, with an idle animation while silent and a sweep while loading.

exports.name: LevelsEngine
exports.summary: What `createLevelsEngine` returns: step it every frame with the input, and read the levels and whether they have settled.

exports.name: LevelsEngineOptions
exports.summary: What a levels engine fits its input to: the bar count, the gain, the shortest level, whether the bars mirror, and what they do while idle, loading or with reduced motion.

exports.name: WaveformIdle
exports.summary: What the bars do while there is no signal: `none` rests them, `pulse` makes them breathe together and `wave` runs a ripple along them.

exports.name: attachWaveformBars
exports.summary: Draws a waveform as `count` elements, `bar(index)` each: writes each one's level, 0…1, to its `--waveform-level` CSS variable, rising at once and falling smoothly, and nothing while they rest or `root` is off screen.

exports.name: WaveformBarsOptions
exports.summary: The options of `attachWaveformBars`: the bar count, the peaks or a live signal, the stretch shown and the played share, and how the bars move.

exports.name: WaveformPlayed
exports.summary: The played share of the audio, 0…1, as it changes.

exports.name: attachWaveformCanvas
exports.summary: Draws a waveform on `canvas`, laid out on the device pixel grid: as many bars as fit its width, every edge on a physical pixel, so it stays sharp at any pixel density and zoom level.

exports.name: WaveformCanvasOptions
exports.summary: The options of `attachWaveformCanvas`: the peaks or a live signal, the stretch shown and the played share, the variant, the bars' size, and how the drawing moves.

exports.name: fitPeaks
exports.summary: Fits the stretch of `peaks` from `from` to `to` (shares of the whole, 0…1) to one high and one low per bar of `envelope`.

exports.name: PeakEnvelope
exports.summary: Where each bar reaches above and below the middle: `high` 0…1 up, `low` 0…-1 down.

exports.name: peakCount
exports.summary: How many entries `peaks` holds.

exports.name: peakMagnitudes
exports.summary: A level per entry of the stretch from `from` to `to`: how far each slice reaches either way.

exports.name: rangeShares
exports.summary: The shares of the whole audio that the stretch `range` covers, for `fitPeaks`: `[start, end]` in `duration` units becomes `[from, to]` in 0…1.

exports.name: WaveformPeaks
exports.summary: The audio's shape, one entry per slice of it: either a level per slice (0…1, drawn the same above and below the middle) or the lowest and highest sample of each slice (-1…1), which draws the waveform as it really is, lopsided where the audio is.

exports.name: createWaveformRegionController

exports.name: WaveformRegionChangeEventDetails

exports.name: WaveformRegionCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture on a region ends: which edge moved, the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: WaveformRegionController

exports.name: WaveformRegionEdge
exports.summary: What a change to a region moves: its start, its end, or the whole region with `"both"`.

exports.name: WaveformRegionOptions
exports.summary: Keys move an edge by this share of the timeline, a large step with Shift or Page Up/Down.

exports.name: WaveformRegionSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a region from.

exports.name: WaveformRegionValue
exports.summary: A region as `[start, end]`, in `duration` units.

exports.name: ScopeOptions
exports.summary: The box `scopePoints` draws into, in px, its inset, and the gain applied to the samples.

exports.name: ScopePoint
exports.summary: A point of the trace, in px.

exports.name: scopePoints
exports.summary: Where a line through `samples` (-1…1 each) goes: left to right across the width, around the middle of the height.

exports.name: createWaveformController
exports.summary: A seekable waveform's behavior with no view attached: its position, held, controlled or live, every way of moving it, and the stretch selected.

exports.name: WaveformSeekChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueChange` receives with each seek: the reason (`"press"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"` or `"input-change"`), the event, and `cancel()` to refuse it.

exports.name: WaveformSeekCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a seek ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: WaveformSeekController
exports.summary: What `createWaveformController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, the hover, and the presses, keys and typed values that seek.

exports.name: WaveformSeekOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createWaveformController`: the position, held, controlled or live, the audio's length and the stretch shown, the steps, and the callbacks.

exports.name: WaveformSeekSnapshot
exports.summary: What a view draws a seekable waveform from.

exports.name: WaveformSelectionChangeEventDetails
exports.summary: A stretch selected by dragging across the waveform with Shift held.

exports.name: WaveformSelectionCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: The end of a stretch selected with Shift held: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.name: WaveformSelectionHandlers
exports.summary: Listens to the stretch a Shift + drag selects: set by the control that is dragged on.

exports.name: createXYPadController

exports.name: XYPadChangeEventReason
exports.summary: Why the value changed: `"press"`, `"drag"`, `"keyboard"`, `"wheel"`, `"input-change"` (a typed value) or `"reset"`.

exports.name: XYPadCommitEventDetails
exports.summary: What `onValueCommitted` receives once a gesture ends: the reason and the event behind it.

exports.summary: Why the value was committed: the same reasons as a change.

exports.name: XYPadController
exports.summary: What `createXYPadController` returns: the snapshot to draw from, and the press, keys, wheel, typed values and reset that move the point.

exports.name: XYPadOptions
exports.summary: The options of `createXYPadController`: the point, held or controlled, each axis's range and step, the formatting and the callbacks.

exports.name: XYPadPoint

exports.summary: One of the pad's two axes.

exports.summary: Shift + arrows and Page Up/Down move this many steps at once.

exports.name: STATE_ATTRIBUTES_MAPPING
exports.summary: Only `disabled` and `dragging` become data attributes; the numbers stay in `state`.

exports.name: toPercent
exports.summary: Where `value` sits between `min` and `max`, from 0 to 1.

exports.name: AutoWarp
exports.summary: How a file plays in time at an arrangement's tempo, as `autoWarp` works it out.

exports.name: autoWarp
exports.summary: The warp that plays a recording of `duration` seconds in time at `tempo` BPM (CLP-019): a short one that a whole number of 1, 2, 4, 8 or 16 bars fits at its estimated tempo, as that loop, marked at its start and end; any other on a marker at the first beat of each bar, moved onto the transient within an eighth of a beat.

exports.name: detectTransients
exports.summary: Where `channels` have their transients, in seconds: each frame where the level rises sharply above what it does around it, found to the sample where the slope first reaches half its height there.

exports.name: TempoEstimate
exports.summary: A recording's tempo, as `@audio/beat-detect` reads it and the registry's `analyzeBeat` fits it to the transients.

exports.name: CompressorSettings
exports.summary: The transfer curve of a compressor: the output level in dB for each input level in dB, the textbook curve with a knee centred on the threshold, what a plug-in draws.

exports.name: compressorOutput
exports.summary: A compressor's transfer curve: the output level in dB for each input level in dB.

exports.name: BiquadSettings
exports.summary: One filter as `biquadResponse` draws it: its type, frequency, gain and Q, at a sample rate.

exports.name: BiquadType
exports.summary: The kinds of band an equalizer draws: cuts, shelves, a peak, a notch and a band-pass.

exports.name: bandGainForHandle
exports.summary: The inverse, for dragging: the gain a band needs at `frequency` for its handle to sit at `responseDb` on the curve, so the handle follows the pointer one to one instead of the gain drifting from it.

exports.name: bandHandleDb
exports.summary: Where a band's handle sits on an equalizer's curve: the response of all the bands at the band's own frequency.

exports.name: biquadResponse
exports.summary: A biquad's gain in dB at `hz`, 0 being unity.

exports.name: EqBand
exports.summary: One band of an equalizer: a filter that can be switched out of the chain.

exports.name: eqResponse
exports.summary: An equalizer's bands in series: their gains in dB add up at each frequency.

exports.name: SAMPLE_RATE
exports.summary: The sample rate a curve is drawn at unless a band says another.

exports.name: toWebAudioQ
exports.summary: The value to give a `BiquadFilterNode`'s `Q` for a band's `q`.

exports.name: WEB_AUDIO_FILTER_TYPES
exports.summary: The Web Audio `BiquadFilterNode` type that does what each band type draws.

exports.name: formatDb
exports.summary: "+3.0 dB", "-6.5 dB", "0.0 dB": a gain with its sign, never "-0.0".

exports.name: dbToGain
exports.summary: The amplitude ratio of a level in dB: 0 dB is 1, -6.02 dB is 0.5.

exports.name: gainToDb
exports.summary: The level in dB of an amplitude ratio: 1 is 0 dB, 0.5 is -6.02 dB.

exports.name: peakDb
exports.summary: The level in dBFS of the loudest sample of `samples`, either way: how near the signal comes to clipping, where `rmsDb` says how loud it sounds.

exports.name: rmsDb
exports.summary: The RMS level of `samples` in dBFS: 0 dB for a square wave at full scale, -3 dB for a sine at full scale.

exports.name: createLoudnessMeter
exports.summary: Measures what is connected to it while it plays, on the audio thread, and calls `onLoudness` with its momentary, short-term and integrated loudness every 100 ms.

exports.name: createLoudnessReader
exports.summary: Reads loudness block by block: `add` takes the K-weighted mean square of the next 100 ms, summed over the channels, as the meter's processor posts it, and gives the loudness up to it.

exports.name: LiveLoudness
exports.summary: How loud a sound is while it plays, in LUFS.

exports.name: LOUDNESS_TARGETS
exports.summary: Targets in LUFS: what streaming services, podcasts and broadcast (EBU R 128) ask a file to be.

exports.name: LOUDNESS_WORKLET
exports.summary: The meter's processor: it K-weights each channel of its input (a high shelf, then a high-pass, with the coefficients `@audio/weighting-k` gives for the context's rate), and posts the mean square of each block of 100 ms, summed over the channels.

exports.name: Loudness
exports.summary: How loud a sound is.

exports.name: LoudnessMeter
exports.summary: A live loudness meter on a context, as `createLoudnessMeter` makes it.

exports.name: loudnessGain
exports.summary: The gain in dB that brings a sound to `target` LUFS, as far as its true peak stays at or under `ceiling` dBTP: a sound that would pass it lands under the target instead, and nothing is limited.

exports.name: measureLoudness
exports.summary: Measures whole channels at once.

exports.name: AudioPeaks
exports.summary: The lowest and highest sample of each slice of the audio, -1 to 1: what the Waveform draws as the waveform really is, lopsided where the audio is.

exports.name: computePeaks
exports.summary: Reduces PCM samples to `bucketCount` slices, keeping each slice's lowest and highest sample across every channel, a take panned hard to one side still draws, rather than reading as a flat line on the channel it isn't on.

exports.name: downsampleWaveform
exports.summary: Downsamples raw PCM samples into `targetLength` blocks, each block's value the peak (max) absolute amplitude within it, the reduction waveform visualizers use, since a block average flattens short transients into a softer-looking curve than the audio actually has.

exports.name: normalizePeaks
exports.summary: Scales peaks so the loudest sample, either way, reaches full height, keeping each slice's lopsidedness.

exports.name: normalizeWaveform
exports.summary: Scales `values` so the largest entry becomes 1, keeps a waveform's peak reaching full height regardless of the source audio's own loudness.

exports.name: SpectrumBandsOptions
exports.summary: The frequencies and levels `spectrumBands` spreads its bands over.

exports.name: spectrumBands
exports.summary: Reduces an analyser's spectrum (`getFloatFrequencyData`: decibels per frequency bin) to `bands.length` levels of 0-1, low to high, written into `bands`.

exports.name: DetectPitchOptions
exports.summary: What `detectPitch` looks for.

exports.name: detectPitch
exports.summary: The pitch the samples hold and how clear it is, or nothing: too quiet a signal, or no clear period.

exports.name: PitchEstimate
exports.summary: What a detection found: the pitch and how periodic the sound is there.

exports.name: analyzeBeat
exports.summary: Reads a recording's beat, once, as it is decoded: what `warpOnImport` warps its clips by.

exports.name: audioChroma
exports.summary: How much of a recording's sound lies in each pitch class, C to B, summing to 1, read once as it is decoded: what a key is read from, with notes or without (`detectKeys` of the Scale menu).

exports.name: BeatAnalysis
exports.summary: What a recording's beat is read as when it comes in: its tempo, if it has one, and its transients, in seconds.

exports.name: holdPeaks
exports.summary: Keeps the loudest level each point of a spectrum reached: a peak rises with the spectrum at once, stays put for `hold` seconds, then falls at `fall` dB per second until the spectrum meets it again.

exports.name: LogSpectrumOptions
exports.summary: The frequencies the axis of `logSpectrum` spans.

exports.name: logSpectrum
exports.summary: Fills `out` with `bins` (dB per analyser bin, as `getFloatFrequencyData` writes them) resampled onto a log axis.

exports.name: PeakHoldOptions
exports.summary: How long `holdPeaks` holds a peak, and how fast it lets it fall.

exports.name: SPECTRUM_FLOOR_DB
exports.summary: The quietest a point is drawn: what a silent bin, `-Infinity` dB, becomes.

exports.name: ChoiceOption
exports.summary: One entry of a choice: the `value` that goes in the state and the `label` a panel shows.

exports.name: ChoiceParameter
exports.summary: A pick from a short list: a waveform, a filter type, a mode.

exports.name: Device
exports.summary: A defined device: its parameters, and everything that reads or changes a state of it, with no sound and no view.

exports.name: DeviceApplied
exports.summary: What `apply` returns: the new state, the changes made, and the changes refused with their reason.

exports.name: DeviceBinding
exports.summary: What a host gives a device to drive: an engine, a view, a store.

exports.name: DeviceChange
exports.summary: One parameter `apply` changed.

exports.name: DeviceContext
exports.summary: What the host knows and the device does not: the tempo a time parameter that follows it is read against.

exports.name: DeviceDefinition
exports.summary: What `defineDevice` takes: the device's id, name, description and parameters, and whether it is an instrument, takes a sidechain or adds latency.

exports.name: DeviceDefinitionError
exports.summary: Raised when a device is defined with parameters that cannot work.

exports.name: DeviceDescription
exports.summary: A device as an agent or a catalog reads it.

exports.name: DeviceReadings
exports.summary: What a device reports about what it is doing right now, for a meter.

exports.name: DeviceRejection
exports.summary: One parameter `apply` did not change, and why.

exports.name: DeviceState
exports.summary: The state of a device: each parameter's id to its value.

exports.name: defineDevice
exports.summary: Defines a device from its parameters.

exports.name: NumberParameter
exports.summary: A continuous parameter: a number in a range, on a scale, in steps.

exports.name: ParameterDescription
exports.summary: A parameter as an agent or a catalog reads it: JSON-safe, with no function in it.

exports.name: ParameterDescriptor
exports.summary: A parameter of a device: a number, a toggle or a choice.

exports.name: ParameterValue
exports.summary: What a parameter holds: a number, a boolean or the value of a choice.

exports.name: ToggleParameter
exports.summary: An on or off parameter: a bypass, a mode, an auto switch.

exports.name: createFeed
exports.summary: Feeds a worklet only while the path it plays is heard: a worklet fed nothing costs nothing.

exports.name: createWorkletStage
exports.summary: A stage of an engine that runs a worklet: the sound passes clean while the worklet loads, then fades over to it.

exports.name: EffectEngine
exports.summary: The engine of an effect on the Web Audio API: the binding of its state (`update`, `dispose`, `readings`) between an input and an output.

exports.name: EngineFactory
exports.summary: What every `create<Name>Engine` is: an engine on a context, for the state it starts with and the host's tempo.

exports.name: FEED_RELEASE_MS
exports.summary: How long after a path stops a worklet is still fed, in ms: its fade is over by then.

exports.name: Feed
exports.summary: Connections made while a path plays and taken away once it has faded out.

exports.name: FeedConnection
exports.summary: A connection a feed makes: `from` into `to`, at an output and an input of their own if given.

exports.name: InstrumentEngine
exports.summary: The engine of an instrument: one voice, notes in, sound out.

exports.name: NoiseColor
exports.summary: The colors of noise a buffer is made in, as `@audio/synth-noise` makes them.

exports.name: noiseBuffer
exports.summary: Two seconds of noise on a context, from `@audio/synth-noise` (seeded, its peak at 0.9), made once per color and context and shared by everything that plays it: a synth's noise source, a snare's rattle, the pink noise an equalizer is heard through.

exports.name: WorkletStage
exports.summary: A worklet that takes over from the clean sound once it is in the graph.

exports.name: InstrumentBinding
exports.summary: What a host gives an instrument to play: a `DeviceBinding` that also takes notes.

exports.name: NoteTiming
exports.summary: When a note starts or ends, and which note it is.

exports.name: playNote
exports.summary: Plays a note for `seconds` on an instrument: `noteOn` now, `noteOff` when the time is up.

exports.name: SidechainBinding
exports.summary: What a host gives a device that takes a key signal: a `DeviceBinding` whose engine has a second input, `sidechain`, that the key is connected to.

exports.name: measureLatency
exports.summary: How long an engine delays a signal, in milliseconds: where what comes out of an impulse lines up with it.

exports.name: measureResponse
exports.summary: How far an engine's frequency response is from `curve`, the gain in dB the device draws at each frequency.

exports.name: ResponseMeasurement
exports.summary: What a measurement of a frequency response found.

exports.name: DeviceTool
exports.summary: A tool a model can call to drive a device: agent-agnostic, with no SDK in it.

exports.name: DeviceToolResult
exports.summary: What a tool's `run` returns: the state after the call, a summary for the model, and the note to play for a `<id>_play` call.

exports.name: deviceTools
exports.summary: The tools that drive a device, derived from its parameters: `<id>_set` takes any of its parameters by id, `<id>_reset` puts some or all back to their defaults.

exports.name: JsonSchema
exports.summary: The subset of JSON Schema the tools use: what OpenAI, Anthropic, MCP and the AI SDK all accept as an input schema.

exports.name: NOTE_DURATION
exports.summary: How long a note lasts when a call does not say, and the shortest and longest it may ask for, in seconds.

exports.name: decodeAudioChannels
exports.summary: Decodes raw audio bytes, such as `file.arrayBuffer()`, into every channel's PCM samples at the context's sample rate, ready for `computePeaks`.

exports.name: decodeAudioSamples
exports.summary: Decodes raw audio bytes into one channel's PCM samples, ready for `downsampleWaveform`: `decodeAudioChannels`, then the channel asked for, or the last there is.

exports.name: AudioFileFormat
exports.summary: The formats `encodeAudio` writes.

exports.name: downloadFile
exports.summary: Saves a file through the browser's downloads, named `name`.

exports.name: encodeAudio
exports.summary: Encodes channels of samples, from -1 to 1, as a file.

exports.name: downloadMidiFile
exports.summary: Saves the notes as a `.mid` file, named `filename`.

exports.name: MIDI_FILE_ACCEPT
exports.summary: What a file input or a drop zone accepts as a MIDI file.

exports.name: MidiFileGrid
exports.summary: The grid notes are read onto: steps a quarter note, the clip's length in steps, and the pitch and tempo ranges it takes.

exports.name: readMidiFile
exports.summary: Reads a MIDI file's notes onto a grid of steps, with the file's own tempo (clamped to the BPM range).

exports.name: readMidiFileParts
exports.summary: Reads a MIDI file as parts, for a host that lays each on a track of its own: a part per track and channel, named after its track (and its channel, when a track holds several), its notes in beats as they were written, not quantized and not cut, at least a tick long, and the first program its channel plays.

exports.name: ScoreNote
exports.summary: A note of a score in beats: where it starts and how long it lasts, in quarter notes.

exports.name: ScorePart
exports.summary: One part of a score: its name, whether it is drums, and its notes in beats.

exports.name: writeMidiFile
exports.summary: The notes as a Standard MIDI File, the inverse of `readMidiFile`.

exports.name: downloadMusicXmlFile
exports.summary: Saves the notes as a `.musicxml` file, named `filename`.

exports.name: MUSICXML_FILE_ACCEPT
exports.summary: What a file input or a drop zone accepts as a MusicXML file: a score, or one compressed as `.mxl`.

exports.name: MusicXmlFileGrid
exports.summary: The grid notes are read onto: steps a quarter note, the clip's length in steps, and the pitch and tempo ranges it takes.

exports.name: readMusicXmlFile
exports.summary: Reads a MusicXML score's notes onto a grid of steps, with its first tempo (clamped to the BPM range), every part into the one clip.

exports.name: readMusicXmlFileParts
exports.summary: Reads a MusicXML score as parts, for a host that lays each on a track of its own: a part each, by its name, its notes in beats as they were written, through changes of tempo, not quantized and not cut.

exports.name: writeMusicXmlFile
exports.summary: The notes as a MusicXML score, the inverse of `readMusicXmlFile`, for a notation app to open: on the grid they sit on, so nothing moves.
