exports.name: createMidiInput
exports.summary: The MIDI inputs of the page through the Web MIDI API, as one source: every listener hears the messages of every connected device, and devices plugged or unplugged later are picked up, and a device switched off with `setInputEnabled` is not heard.

exports.name: MidiInput
exports.summary: The page's MIDI inputs as one source: connect, listen to messages, switch inputs off, and follow its state.

exports.name: MidiInputState
exports.summary: What `createMidiInput` knows of the page's MIDI: whether it is supported and connected, the inputs, the muted ones, and why it is not connected.

exports.name: DEFAULT_PITCH_BEND_RANGE
exports.summary: The bend range most synths start with, in semitones.

exports.name: MidiMessage
exports.summary: Live MIDI 1.0 channel messages, as a Web MIDI input delivers them (one message per event, a status byte then its data bytes).

exports.name: parseMidiMessage
exports.summary: Parses one channel voice message: note on, note off, control change or pitch bend.

exports.name: pitchBendToSemitones
exports.summary: A pitch bend value in semitones, for a receiver whose bend range is `range` semitones each way.

exports.name: detectKeys
exports.summary: The keys `notes` are likeliest in, likeliest first, at most `count`: each pitch class weighed by how long it sounds, against the major and minor key profiles of `@audio/mir-key` (Krumhansl-Schmuckler).

exports.name: KeyNote
exports.summary: What a key is read from: a note's pitch and how long it lasts, in any unit.

exports.name: inScale
exports.summary: Whether a MIDI pitch is in a scale.

exports.name: nearestInScale
exports.summary: The pitch in a scale nearest `pitch`: itself when it is in it, else the nearest one, the lower of two as near.

exports.name: rollScale
exports.summary: A scale as a piano roll reads it: its pitch classes and its root, what `@audio-ui/core/piano-roll` takes.

exports.name: SCALES
exports.summary: The steps of each scale, as semitones above the root.

exports.name: Scale
exports.summary: A scale on a root: C major is `{ name: "major", root: 0 }`.

exports.name: ScaleName
exports.summary: The name of a scale of `SCALES`.

exports.name: scalePitchClasses
exports.summary: The pitch classes a scale keeps, from 0 (C) to 11 (B), in order.

exports.name: ArrangedAudio
exports.summary: An audio clip as an arrangement holds it, in seconds: where it lies, the stretch of its recording it plays, its gain, loop, direction and warp.

exports.name: createWarpReader
exports.summary: Reads a warp map from a clip's own time back to its source's, fast enough to be asked for every frame: it keeps the stretch it last answered from, since frames come in order.

exports.name: PlayedClip
exports.summary: An audio clip as a player reads it: in whole frames of the arrangement, at the engine's sample rate.

exports.name: PlayedStretch
exports.summary: How a clip stretches time, in frames of the arrangement: how far apart its grains start and how long they cross, how fast each reads, and whether each is lined up on the last.

exports.name: playedClip
exports.summary: The clip a player reads from `clip`, playing the recording `recording`, at `sampleRate`: every time turned into the nearest frame, the fades shortened to fit, the gain as a ratio.

exports.name: playedClips
exports.summary: The clips a track's player reads, from an arrangement's audio clips: those that play (not deactivated, with a recording to play), each through `playedClip`, in the order they start.

exports.name: WarpMode
exports.summary: How a clip plays at another speed than its recording's: with its pitch moving with it, in slices that keep their attacks, or in grains that keep a held note.

exports.name: RECORDING_LOADER_WORKER
exports.summary: The loader of streamed recordings, as the source of a module: start it with `new Worker(url, { type: "module" })` (from a Blob URL), then post it `RecordingLoaderMessage`s.

exports.name: Compensation
exports.summary: How long each path waits, in frames, so that all of them line up at the main track.

exports.name: DelayedTrack
exports.summary: A path into the mixer as delay compensation sees it: how many frames its devices delay it.

exports.name: delayCompensation
exports.summary: The waits that line every path up at the main track.

exports.name: panGains
exports.summary: The gains of the left and right channels for a pan from -1 (left) to 1 (right): a constant-power law on sine curves, with both channels at unity in the centre and the side it is turned to at +3 dB at either end.

exports.name: RoutedCompensation
exports.summary: How long each path waits, in frames, so that everything meeting anywhere meets on the same frame.

exports.name: RoutedTrack
exports.summary: A path into the mixer as routing sees it: its delay, where it plays into, and the returns it sends to.

exports.name: routedCompensation
exports.summary: The waits that line every path up wherever paths meet: at a group, the sound of each of its tracks; at a return, each send; at the main track, the top tracks and groups and the returns.

exports.name: SoloState
exports.summary: What a solo lets through: each track's own output, and each of its sends.

exports.name: SoloTrack
exports.summary: A track as the solo sees it.

exports.name: soloState
exports.summary: Which tracks a solo silences.

exports.name: PlannedRecording
exports.summary: What the planner needs of a recording: its rate and its length in frames.

exports.name: pagesAhead
exports.summary: The pages a track's clips read over the `count` frames of the audio clock from `frame`, the soonest read first: what a loader should have in the pool before then.

exports.name: CLIP_PLAYER_PROCESSOR
exports.summary: The name the clip player's processor is registered under in an AudioWorklet.

exports.name: ClipPlayerMessage
exports.summary: What the main thread posts to a clip player's port.

exports.name: ClipPlayerReply
exports.summary: What a clip player's processor posts back.

exports.name: RecordingLoaderMessage
exports.summary: What the main thread posts to the loader of streamed recordings, a Worker.

exports.name: RecordingLoaderReply
exports.summary: What the loader posts back.

exports.name: DECLICK_SECONDS
exports.summary: How long a stop or a jump fades the sound out, and the sound after a jump in.

exports.name: DecodedRecording
exports.summary: A recording held in memory, decoded: one array of samples per channel.

exports.name: Recording
exports.summary: A recording a clip plays: decoded in memory, or streamed.

exports.name: Recordings
exports.summary: The recordings a player can read, by id.

exports.name: renderClips
exports.summary: Adds what `clips` play over `length` frames of the arrangement from `position` into `output`, from index `at`.

exports.name: StreamedRecording
exports.summary: A recording read from the pages of a stream, which something else keeps filled ahead of playback.

exports.name: sourceIndexer
exports.summary: Where in its recording `clip` reads at the arrangement's frame `frame`, in frames of the recording (fractional when warped or at another rate), or NaN where it plays nothing: what both the player and the planner of a stream's pages follow.

exports.name: TrackRenderer
exports.summary: What one track plays, block after block: its clips, through the states of the transport it is given, each from its own frame of the audio clock.

exports.name: createPagePool
exports.summary: A pool of `slots` pages, in shared memory unless `shared` is false.

exports.name: createRecordingStream
exports.summary: A recording of `length` frames read from `pool`, none of its pages there yet.

exports.name: PAGE_FRAMES
exports.summary: How many frames a page holds: about 0.7 s at 48 kHz.

exports.name: PageCache
exports.summary: Keeps the pages that are asked for in the pool: it loads those missing, in the order they come, into free slots or into the slots asked for longest ago, and never into a slot asked for in the same call.

exports.name: PagePool
exports.summary: The slots every streamed recording of a context reads from.

exports.name: PageReader
exports.summary: Reads a page of a recording into its slot: one array per channel of the recording, `pageFrames` long, to fill from the page's first frame.

exports.name: PageRequest
exports.summary: One page of one recording.

exports.name: RecordingStream
exports.summary: A recording as the player reads it from the pool.

exports.name: slotOffset
exports.summary: Where a slot's channel starts in the pool's samples.

exports.name: streamedSample
exports.summary: A channel's sample at a frame: silence outside the recording, and while its page is not there.

exports.name: arrangementFrame
exports.summary: The frame of the arrangement that plays at the audio clock's `frame`, at or after `state.at`: the state's position while stopped.

exports.name: continuesFrom
exports.summary: Whether going from `before` to `after` at `after.at` carries on without a break: both play, and the frame of the arrangement at `after.at` is the same in both.

exports.name: heardFrame
exports.summary: The frame of the audio clock heard at the speakers at `contextTime`, the context's time of what is heard now (`getOutputTimestamp().contextTime`, or `currentTime` less the output latency where the browser has no timestamp), less `delay` frames the engine adds on the way (its delay compensation).

exports.name: PlaybackRun
exports.summary: A stretch of a block that plays frames of the arrangement one after the other.

exports.name: PlaybackState
exports.summary: What the transport does from a frame of the audio clock on.

exports.name: playbackRuns
exports.summary: The runs of the block of `count` frames from the audio clock's `frame`: the arrangement's frames it plays, cut where the loop comes round.

exports.name: rescaled
exports.summary: The state that carries on from the audio clock's frame `at` once every time of the arrangement is `ratio` times what it was (a change of tempo: half the tempo makes every time twice as late): the position playing at `at`, and the loop, scaled, so the playhead stays on its bar and beat.

exports.name: STOPPED
exports.summary: Stopped at the start, from the first frame on.

exports.name: startsInWindow
exports.summary: The items that start in the block of `count` frames from the audio clock's `frame`, each with the frame of the clock it starts at: what a scheduler of notes asks for its look-ahead window.

exports.name: toFrames
exports.summary: A time in seconds as a whole number of frames: the nearest one.

exports.name: CLIP_PLAYER_WORKLET
exports.summary: The clip player's processor, as the source of a module: load it into a context with `audioWorklet.addModule` (from a Blob URL), then make a player with `new AudioWorkletNode(context, CLIP_PLAYER_PROCESSOR)`.

exports.name: CLIP_PLAYER_WORKLET_INPUTS
exports.summary: A hash of the sources this bundle was made from, checked by a test.

exports.name: adjacentDivision
exports.summary: The fixed division next to `division`: a finer one (`direction` 1, twice as dense) or a coarser one (-1), held at the ends of the list.

exports.name: barLabelInterval
exports.summary: Seconds between labelled bars on a ruler at `zoom` px per second: always a whole number of bars, doubled until labels are at least `minSpacing` px apart, so they never collide or fall mid-bar.

exports.name: DOTTED_FACTOR
exports.summary: Three halves: a dotted note is its straight one and half again.

exports.name: divisionAt
exports.summary: The fixed division whose step is nearest `seconds` at `tempo`: what a grid that follows the zoom becomes when it is fixed where it is.

exports.name: divisionSeconds
exports.summary: How long one fixed division lasts at `tempo`, in seconds.

exports.name: FixedGridDivision
exports.summary: The id of a fixed grid division: `"4-bars"` to `"1/32"`.

exports.name: GRID_DIVISIONS
exports.summary: The fixed grid divisions, coarsest first: a number of bars, or a note value.

exports.name: GridDivision
exports.summary: `adaptive` follows the zoom; a fixed division stays put however far you zoom.

exports.name: GridIntervalOptions
exports.summary: How close adaptive grid lines may be, and whether the grid is in triplets.

exports.name: gridInterval
exports.summary: Seconds between grid lines at `zoom` px per second: the lines a timeline draws and the step it snaps to, so what you see is where you land.

exports.name: gridLabel
exports.summary: Names an interval the way a grid readout does: "1 bar", "4 bars", "1/16", "1/8T".

exports.name: METRONOME_RHYTHMS
exports.summary: How often a metronome clicks: with the beat, or a note value, straight or triplet.

exports.name: MetronomeRhythm
exports.summary: The id of a metronome rhythm: `"auto"` (the beat), a bar, or a note value, straight or triplet.

exports.name: metronomeRhythmSeconds
exports.summary: Seconds between clicks for a rhythm, or `null` for `auto`, which has no interval of its own: it is the beat, whatever the signature makes one.

exports.name: SYNCED_DIVISIONS
exports.summary: The note values a time parameter that follows the tempo can take, shortest first: `1/16` is a sixteenth note, `1/8t` a triplet eighth (two thirds of it) and `1/8d` a dotted eighth (one and a half times it).

exports.name: SyncedDivision
exports.summary: A note value as `syncedSeconds` reads it: `"1/8"`, its triplet `"1/8t"` or its dotted `"1/8d"`.

exports.name: syncedSeconds
exports.summary: How long a synced note value lasts at `tempo`, in seconds: `1/8` an eighth, `1/8t` its triplet, `1/8d` its dotted one.

exports.name: TRIPLET_FACTOR
exports.summary: Three in the space of two: a triplet division is 2/3 of its straight one.

exports.name: Bar
exports.summary: A bar as a ruler draws it.

exports.name: barsBeatsWith
exports.summary: Where `seconds` falls in bars, beats and sixteenths through the signature changes, each counted from one.

exports.name: barsOf
exports.summary: The bars from 0 to `until` seconds, through the signature changes: whole bars of each signature, and a partial bar where a change cuts one short.

exports.name: isSignature
exports.summary: Whether a signature is one a bar can have: 1 to 99 beats of a whole, half, quarter, eighth or sixteenth note.

exports.name: MetronomeClick
exports.summary: A click of a metronome.

exports.name: metronomeClicks
exports.summary: The clicks of a metronome from 0 to `until` seconds, through the signature changes.

exports.name: SignatureChange
exports.summary: A new signature from `at` on, in seconds: `beatsPerBar` beats of a `beatUnit` note.

exports.name: advance
exports.summary: Advances `cursor`, emitting every step boundary now within `SCHEDULE_AHEAD_SECONDS` of `now`.

exports.name: anchoredCursor
exports.summary: A cursor that emits `step` at `now`, the seed for `start()` and for every re-anchor (seek, region commit).

exports.name: anchorForTempoChange
exports.summary: The anchor to carry on with when the tempo changes while playing.

exports.name: MAX_CATCH_UP_SECONDS
exports.summary: How late a boundary may be and still be played, half a second.

exports.name: positionAt
exports.summary: The continuous playhead position, in fractional full-grid steps, at `now`.

exports.name: SCHEDULE_AHEAD_SECONDS
exports.summary: How far ahead of `now` boundaries are committed, in seconds: the article's 100 ms.

exports.name: SCHEDULER_POLL_MS
exports.summary: How often to poll the scheduler, in milliseconds: the article's 25 ms.

exports.name: SchedulerAnchor
exports.summary: The audio-time / step pair a running clock is anchored to, for deriving the display position.

exports.name: SchedulerConfig
exports.summary: What the scheduler steps through: the window of steps it loops over and how long a step lasts, read on every call.

exports.name: SchedulerCursor
exports.summary: Where the scheduler is: the next step it will emit and when.

exports.name: StepBoundary
exports.summary: A step to play and the audio time it starts at.

exports.name: BarsBeats
exports.summary: A position in bars, beats and sixteenths, each counted from one.

exports.name: barsBeatsAt
exports.summary: Where `seconds` falls in bars, beats and sixteenths, each counted from one.

exports.name: bpmToMicrosecondsPerQuarterNote
exports.summary: A tempo in BPM as microseconds per quarter note, the unit a MIDI file stores: 120 BPM is 500000.

exports.name: DEFAULT_MICROSECONDS_PER_QUARTER_NOTE
exports.summary: What a file with no Set Tempo event plays at: 120 BPM, 500,000 microseconds a quarter note.

exports.name: DEFAULT_TEMPO
exports.summary: 120 BPM in 4/4.

exports.name: describeBarsBeats
exports.summary: "Bar 3, beat 2", the way a position is read out to a screen reader.

exports.name: microsecondsPerQuarterNoteToBpm
exports.summary: The BPM of a Set Tempo's microseconds per quarter note: 500000 is 120.

exports.name: secondsPerBar
exports.summary: Seconds per bar: a beat times the beats in a bar.

exports.name: secondsPerBeat
exports.summary: Seconds per beat, a beat being one `beatUnit` note: in 6/8, half a quarter.

exports.name: secondsPerQuarter
exports.summary: Seconds per quarter note: BPM counts quarters whatever the signature says.

exports.name: Tempo
exports.summary: Tempo and time signature: how long a quarter note, a beat and a bar last in seconds, and where a position in seconds falls in bars and beats.

exports.name: addWarpMarker
exports.summary: Adds a marker at a time on the clip, pinning what plays there; nothing changes in how it plays until it moves.

exports.name: moveWarpMarker
exports.summary: Moves the marker at `index` to a new time on the clip, stretching the recording on either side of it: it stops short of its neighbours.

exports.name: removeWarpMarker
exports.summary: Takes the marker at `index` away, as long as two are left to make a map.

exports.name: scaleWarp
exports.summary: Plays the whole map `factor` times as long: 2 is half the speed, an octave down; 0.5 twice the speed.

exports.name: unwarpedTime
exports.summary: What time in the source plays at a time on the clip.

exports.name: WarpMarker
exports.summary: A time in the source, pinned to a time on the clip.

exports.name: warpedTime
exports.summary: Where on the clip a time in the source plays.

exports.name: warpMarkers
exports.summary: The markers that make a map: finite ones, in order, each later than the one before in both times.

exports.name: warpRate
exports.summary: How fast the source plays at a time on the clip: 1 as recorded, 2 twice as fast.

exports.name: loadWorklet
exports.summary: Loads the source of an `AudioWorklet` processor into a context, from a blob, so there is no file to serve.
